_readme: §PER-CITY-MEASUREMENTS (L-662) — the three EXPENSIVE C63 axes (LEGISLATION 25 · ENVELOPE 20 ·
HEIGHTS 10 = 55 % of the ratified weight) are AUDITS, not config reads, so computeScorecard.mjs
will not score them without a committed, reviewable measurement record. Absent ⇒ not-assessed.
Modelled on murcia.measurements.json, the first such record in the repo.
⚠ `status: 'measured'` is the ONLY key that unlocks an axis. Never set it to make a number appear.
⚠ Every figure below was RE-QUERIED LIVE against the publisher on 2026-08-01 — none is carried
forward from the dossier. Where a re-query DISAGREED with the dossier, the live number is used
and the disagreement is named in the note. INV-3: cited derivation, never a guess.
⚠⚠ READ THIS BEFORE READING THE NUMBERS. Córdoba's ENVELOPE axis measures 0.0 %, and that is a
MEASURED ZERO, not a missing measurement. PRYZM publishes NO buildable envelope anywhere in
Córdoba today: the honesty gate `CORDOBA_ENVELOPE_VERIFIED` is false AND the COACo subzone
resolver is authored but never called, so not one parcel can bind a subzone. Until 2026-08-01
the axis would have scored ABOVE zero for the wrong reason — 95.1 % of the city's SUELO URBANO
was receiving a FABRICATED estimated envelope (3,0/1,5/3,0 m, FAR 2,00, coverage 50 %). Scoring
that as coverage is what C63 §1.1 exists to forbid. 0.0 % is the improvement.

note: ⚠ THE DENOMINATOR IS AN UPPER BOUND ON PRIVATE BUILDABLE LAND, AND IT IS DELIBERATE.
L-656 ratifies the denominator as private BUILDABLE land. Córdoba's cannot be measured city-wide:
outside the 2-district COACo pilot there is NO vector calificación at all, so viario, espacios
libres and equipamientos cannot be separated from private plots. SUELO URBANO (33.342 km²)
INCLUDES those public systems, so it OVER-states the denominator and every share below is a
LOWER BOUND. That is the safe direction, and it is stated rather than silently assumed.
⚠ It does not move today's score by a single point: every slice's tier weight is 0.0, so the
axis reads 0.0 % under any denominator. The choice matters only for the ceilings below.
MEASURED, NOT EXTRAPOLATED: inside the pilot districts the private-buildable subset IS
measurable — ordenanzas 1 628 615.63 m² + `usos_globales` lucrative (Residencial +
Industrial/Terciario) 222 519.65 m² = 1 851 135.28 m², i.e. 37.3 % of the two districts'
4 961 344.6 m². That ratio is RECORDED AND NOT APPLIED to the rest of the city.
⭐ NEW EVIDENCE THIS PASS: the two layers were tested for overlap and are DISJOINT — 0 of 48
lucrative `usos_globales` centroids fall inside an `ordenanzas` polygon and 0 of 453 the other
way — so the dossier's additive denominator is now verified, not assumed.
GEOMETRY SELF-CHECK: hole-corrected shoelace over the 453 ordenanza polygons = 1 628 300.77 m²
vs the publisher's own Σ `sup_m2` 1 628 615.63 m² = −0.0193 %. (⚠ WITHOUT subtracting interior
rings it reads +1.32 %; the dossier's quoted −0.019 % is the hole-corrected figure and is
reproduced exactly. The 1 628 301 m² that appears in ENVELOPE.md is that shoelace sum, not the
publisher's attribute total — they are two different numbers and had been quoted as one.)
THE SEVEN SLICES ARE NON-OVERLAPPING AND SUM TO 1.000000 OF SUELO URBANO — nothing is
renormalised away, so `measuredShare` = 1.0 and the axis reports over 100 % of the frame.
⚠⚠ WHY EVERY TIER IS 0.0, STATED SO IT IS NOT MISREAD AS A PENALTY. Two different things are
being scored 0 and only one of them is a gap:
• `not-determined` (2.962 pp of SUELO URBANO) — the PGOU itself, or a preservation/overlay
regime, grants no zone envelope: 728 522.65 m² delegated to a Plan Parcial / Plan Especial /
PERI / Estudio de Detalle, 222 519.65 m² of lucrative `usos_globales` (48 of 48 carry an
`actuacion`), and 36 345.97 m² of Campo de la Verdad (Art. 13.4.1 → Tomo VI) + Elemento
protegido (Art. 13.3) + Uso Comercial (Art. 13.12.2). These are TERMINAL, CITED, CORRECT
ANSWERS. C63 §1.5 / L-656: a refusal is a correct answer, and a correct answer is not an
envelope. Scoring them above 0 would claim coverage the law does not grant.
• `no-pack` (97.038 pp) — PRYZM's side. 94.448 pp is land with no machine-readable
calificación (CLOSURE-REGISTER blocker 22: the GMU publishes it as 77 raster sheets and
COACo has vectorised 8 — `coaco:hojas_cus` returns exactly 8, re-verified this date — so it
is an in-house raster→vector acquisition, NOT a hole in the law). 2.583 pp is pilot land
whose ordenanza IS packed and still renders nothing, because the signature and the resolver
call are both outstanding (blockers 2 + 3). 0.008 pp is the dead `O_UAS1` publisher link.
THE ARITHMETIC MAXIMUM, so nobody mistakes 0.0 % for a number that is one sprint from 30 %:
• blockers 2 + 3 alone (signature + resolver call) move the 1.7025 pp of PGOU-direct, packed,
non-MC land to `estimated-ruleset` (0.4) ⇒ axis ≈ 0.68 %.
• blocker 8 as well (a Córdoba street-width resolver for the Manzana Cerrada height table)
adds the 0.8800 pp of MC ⇒ axis ≈ 1.03 %.
• `authoritative` is UNREACHABLE and must not be proposed (CLOSURE-REGISTER blocker 19: the
ordinance exists in exactly one published form — the COACo-served scans — so no second
publisher can corroborate the NUMBERS). A signature authorises `estimated-ruleset` and
nothing above it, exactly as Murcia's SIG-MU1 does.
• Only blocker 22 changes the order of magnitude, and the honest statement of its size is that
PRYZM CANNOT PREDICT IT: 52.87 % of the pilot's ordenanza land is PGOU-direct and packed,
but applying that ratio to the un-vectorised 94.448 pp would be exactly the extrapolation
that produced the withdrawn '~19 % / ~89 %' figures. It is not applied here.

⚠ NUMERATOR = 4, NOT 5, AND THE MISSING ONE IS A DELIBERATE DEDUCTION. PRYZM holds transcribed
rules for FIVE families. **Unifamiliar Adosada is NOT counted**: CLOSURE-REGISTER blocker 4 (D1)
records that Art. 13.9.3.3 states a *profundidad máxima edificable* — UAD-1 16 m · UAD-2 18 m ·
UAD-3 16 m, verified at 380 dpi — and the pack carries NONE of it. The OCR pass verified that the
values we hold are RIGHT; it did not verify that we hold what the article STATES, and the omission
OVER-states (on UAD-3: front 0 + side 0 party-wall + rear 5 m and no depth band = the L-616
whole-parcel overstatement verbatim). A family with a known over-stating omission is not a
verified transcription. ⚠ The alternative reading (count it, 5/10 = 50 %) is recorded here so the
founder can move it deliberately; the lower number was chosen because the ambiguity is ours.
⚠ AN ALTERNATIVE RULER, MEASURED AND REJECTED AS TOO FLATTERING: by the routing key the
dispatcher actually binds on — the 15 distinct `link` documents COACo references — PRYZM holds a
packed subzone for 9 (O_MC1/2/3/4 · O_OA1 · O_CTP1 · O_PAS2 · O_UAD1 · O_UAD3) = 60 %. The family
ruler is used instead because it matches Murcia's convention (families the zone-GIS returns),
keeping the board comparable, and because it is the less flattering of the two.
⭐ A DOSSIER CLAIM MEASURED AND REFUTED THIS PASS. ENVELOPE.md and CLOSURE-REGISTER blockers 2/4
state '7 of the 13 registered subzones bind ZERO pilot land (PAS-1 · PAS-3 · OA-2 · UAD-2 · UAD-3
· MC-1 · MC-3)'. Measured live through the SHIPPED `subzoneCodeFromLink` parse: **4 bind zero —
MC-1 994.50 m² (0.061 %). The register CONTRADICTS ITSELF on this: its own 94.33 % routing
fraction is only reachable if those three bind (Σ over the 9 bound codes = 1 536 241.53 m² =
94.328 % — reproduced exactly). ⚠ CONSEQUENCE, and it is a severity change not a typo: blocker 4
argues D1 is 'latent, not live' because 'UAD-3 binds 0.00 % of published pilot land'. That premise
is FALSE. D1 is latent today only because the gate is shut, and — by the centroid method — 100 %
of UAD-3's bound land sits inside a delegating ámbito, which protects it only if blocker 3's
`derivedPlanningOverride` branch is actually CALLED, and it is not.
⚠ documentInRepo: FALSE, and it is a MILDER state than Murcia's. The 15 ordinance documents were
re-fetched this date: 13 serve a real `application/pdf` (O_MC2 1 243 005 B, O_CTP1 3 156 020 B,
O_EP 3 650 124 B, …) and 2 — `O_UAD1.pdf` and `O_UAS1.pdf` — return the same 69-byte
'Server under construction' HTML (md5 `75a5f3192d98343b18570f62ee57152a`). So the corpus is
publicly RETRIEVABLE (unlike Murcia's HTTP 403); it is simply not COMMITTED, so a reviewer must
re-fetch to check a quote. C63 routes that to DATA-SOURCES, not to a silent discount here.
⭐ Incidental measurement, recorded because its interpretation is UNRESOLVED and someone will
otherwise re-derive it: all five MC documents are exactly 1 243 005 B, and `O_MC3.pdf` ≡
`O_MC4.pdf` byte-for-byte (md5 `8b7e5cf0a0c0820b5a581dcfca95e730`) even though MC-3 and MC-4
differ materially (0.70 vs 0.90 upper-floor coverage). `O_MC.pdf`, `O_MC1.pdf` and `O_MC2.pdf`
have three further distinct hashes at that same length. Equal length + differing hash is
consistent with one document re-issued with different metadata; it is NOT evidence that the
content differs per subzone, and it is NOT claimed to be. It does bear on blocker 7.
⚠ supersessionChecked: FALSE. Every quote comes from the Texto Refundido Oct. 2002. No diff
against later modificaciones puntuales has been run, and Andalucía's post-24-Apr-2026 VITUA
regime means a superseding instrument would publish elsewhere. Concordance UNVERIFIED.
signedVerification FALSE — `sources/VERIFICATION.md` §SIG-1 is prepared and unsigned; signing is

note: ⚠ THIS RECORD IS A PRE-BAKE BASELINE, DELIBERATELY. A national buildings bake is IN FLIGHT on
this SHA. Re-probe and update after it publishes. Do NOT edit these counts to predict the
outcome (§SIZE-IS-NOT-PROVENANCE — a green bake is precisely what L-658 produced while shipping
nothing measured).
measured-lidar = 0. Of 11 812 footprints read from the shipped tiles, ZERO carry the
`pryzm:height_src=measured-lidar` marker: 32 are OSM-surveyed `height` tags, 5 417 are derived
from `building:levels`, and 6 363 render the FABRICATED 9 m default. Tile read was clean —
100 covering tiles, 97 read, 3 absent, 0 FAILED — so this is a genuine `unmeasured` verdict and
not a network claim (L-422/457/467/469).
⚠⚠ A CORRECTION TO THIS RECORD'S OWN FIRST DRAFT, KEPT VISIBLE. It claimed the close-out
brief's '0 of 5 409 measured; 45 % fabricated' had CONFLATED the population with the
`derived-levels` bucket (5 417). THAT WAS WRONG, and it was a guess dressed as a finding — the
exact failure this whole pass exists to stop. `heightSources.mjs` records the real provenance of
that figure: an earlier probe of the SAME shipped tiles at the DEFAULT `--half-deg 0.008` found
5 409 footprints (tagged 17 · derived-levels 2 944 · assumed 2 448 = 45.3 % assumed). It is
internally consistent and it is not the same measurement as this one. THE TWO NUMBERS DIFFER
BECAUSE THE EXTENTS DIFFER: 0.008° is the client's NEAR ring, 0.02° reaches further into the
periphery where fewer buildings carry a `building:levels` tag, so the assumed share rises
53.9 % > 45.3 %. Both are true of their own bbox. ⚠ A half-degree must be quoted with any
Córdoba height figure or the two records will keep appearing to contradict each other.
The axis scores `tagged`/total ONLY (C63 §3 Axis 6 v1: `derived-levels` earns NO partial credit
until the §8 founder decision lands), so 32/11 812 = 0.271 % at half-deg 0.02.
⚠ CÓRDOBA IS NOT MURCIA'S §MURCIA-HEIGHT-STAMP-GAP — checked, not assumed. It is declared in
`REGION_SOURCE` ('mds_edificacion') and present in `MDS_CITY_BBOXES`, i.e. in both the
priorityBboxes and the retainBboxes working set. It is simply not yet baked.
⭐ ONE REAL DEFECT WAS FOUND HERE AND IS NOW FIXED BY SOMEONE ELSE (`e8254bfa`, orchestrator —
this agent deliberately did NOT edit heightSources.mjs, a national bake being in flight): the MDS
stamp bbox ended at n=37.93 while the canonical terrain region reaches 37.94, so a ~1.1 km strip
across the north of Córdoba could never have been stamped no matter how many bakes ran. Now
[-4.85, 37.83, -4.72, 37.94], and pinned by `tools/context-bake/__tests__/
mdsBboxCoversTerrainRegion.spec.ts`. ⚠ The counts in this record are UNCHANGED by that fix and
must not be adjusted to predict the re-bake — they are a PRE-BAKE baseline of the shipped tiles.
⭐ AN UNEXPLOITED CÓRDOBA-SPECIFIC HEIGHT SOURCE, found while probing the publisher and recorded
here because nothing in the dossier names it: COACo serves `coaco:vhex25_max_plantas` (9 202 hex
features) and `coaco:vcatastro_urbanismo` carries per-parcel `max_plantas` / `max_plantasbr` /
`sup_brasante_m2` populated on 5 721 of 5 725 pilot parcels. That is a Catastro-derived STOREY
count, not a LiDAR height, so it would enter the ladder as `derived-levels`, not `measured-lidar`
— it cannot raise this axis under the v1 rule, and it covers the pilot only. Recorded as a
candidate, explicitly NOT counted.
